Subject: Your anticipatory bail matter - Anticipatory Bail Application No. 2135/2019

Dear Ms. Bhandari,

Thank you for meeting us on 05/12/2019 about your dispute with Rajesh Tiwari. As we understand it, the complaint was filed during a matrimonial dispute. The matter is listed before the Hyderabad Sessions Court.

Our advice is to seek interim protection and offer to attend mediation. Please collect the marriage certificate and messages showing attempts to settle and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹15,10,000.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
